data.reason_zh: 进化式生成并筛选证明器接口特性，保留有效改进并形成可复用MCP服务器，且在留出集和Lean迁移上验证。

scope_support.feedback_quote: only keeps the ones that improve the overall performance of smaller models.
scope_support.object_quote: We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method by growing, on a curated set of mathematical problems, ROCQ-MCP-EVOLVE, a new MCP server for the Rocq prover.
scope_support.persistence_quote: Although evolved for Rocq, the resulting server transfers to Lean, improving cost and time per solve on a subset of PutnamBench.
